Each ingredient is checked against all six international databases.
Unflagged ingredients contribute positively to the score.
Flagged ingredients reduce the score based on their classification level in ECHA or IARC.
The final score reflects the proportion of flagged versus unflagged ingredients.

This mathematical approach ensures the score is an objective output of database cross-referencing — not a subjective human opinion. The burden of scientific truth falls entirely on ECHA, IARC, and Codex Alimentarius — not on Hêja.
Every flagged ingredient includes a direct link to the database entry or research paper that mentions it. You can verify every claim independently.
